body:
After reading 'New Hash Honey Oil Technique' in the Erowid cannabis vault I was eager to try it for myself. As I couldnt afford the qauntitys used by Indra I decided to improvise a slightly simpler method. First I crumbled the hash into a paper towel and folded it so that the hash was held in a ball within it. Then I filled a shot glass with butane (i found that placing a thick material over the nozzle of the butane helped to get the liquid butane into the glass before it evaporated). Then I placed the paper towel containing the hash into the butane. I left the hash in the butane for several minutes until most of the butane had evaporated. I then removed the towel from the glass while there was still butane evaporating so as to not get some of the precious oil stuck to it. I was quite surprised to see when the towel was opened that the hash had turned into a fine sandy/grey colored powder. After a few minutes the rest of the butane had evaporated and what was left was an amber colored substance. As best I could I placed this substance in my vaporizer and shared it with my friend. Both of us were extremely surprised with the potency of this stuff and also quite pleased to c it practicaly vanish in the vaporizer. I hope this helps someone.
